ai_summary: System-installed always-on voice activation service (OneVoice / Snapdragon Voice Activation). A 16 kHz PCM16 stream is turned into 80-bin mel features (480-sample 30 ms frames, 160-sample hop, Hann-400 window, 512-point FFT, sparse triangular mel bank), then scored by a 1st-stage keyword network (PDK5_XS / PDK6_XS+MFCN), refined by a 1.5-stage network, and gated by a 2nd-stage speaker-verification model (DNN-UV/VOP/TIVOP over a GMM UBM or an EAI network). A separate eAI DNN VAD (assets/speech_float.eai) segments speech, and Whisper (libwhisper_lib.so + a runtime-downloaded SNPE .dlc encoder) provides ASR. All neural networks are Qualcomm EAI2 blobs; the container formats (.uim and eai2 headers) are decoded here, the EAI2 layer tables are not.

features.name: Always-on keyword detection (OneVoice, 1st stage -> 1.5 stage -> 2nd stage UV)
pipeline: AudioRecord(16000 Hz, CHANNEL_IN_MONO, PCM16) or SoundTrigger STHAL partitions
frame 480 samples / hop 160 -> x*(1/32768) * Hann(400) -> 512-pt real FFT -> 256 magnitudes -> 80 sparse triangular mel filters (no log)
DNN VAD (speech_float.eai via libdnnvad_jni -> libqvavad -> libeai_floating), threshold 0.85 (Q20 891289), hangover 70 frames
1st stage keyword net (PdkXSCore, eai2 blobs in *.uim), 5 keyword scores, threshold 26/40 or per-keyword thresholds 55,61,36,35,33
1.5 stage keyword net (eai2 in 1.5_stage/*.uim), MiddleStageKW.thresholds 50,52,49,37,35
2nd stage user verification (Stage2UVCore / DNN-UV/TIVOP over general_UV_015|024), SecondStageUV.threshold 13.0/55.0, kwcmd 19.0/45.0
tolerance window KW.pre/postTolerance 300-400/440 ms, UV.pre/post 200 ms -> RecognitionEvent
features.notes: Model choice is SOC-id driven (SocIdModelMapper/KwModelMapper): soc 557,577 -> 1st stage _038 (PDK6_XS MFCN, no 1.5 stage); 519,536 -> _001; 454,472/507,565 -> _040; 506,547,564/530,531,540,591/537,583/568,602 -> _036. general_UV_015 is the keyword-dependent UV UBM, general_UV_024 the platform (TIUV) UBM. Android wiring (patch pass): the trigger is the sound-trigger HAL; the app registers a SoundTriggerModule session from WakewordToggleService, then on each event opens AudioRecord with capture preset 1999 (AUDIO_SOURCE_HOTWORD) to fetch the utterance. Delivery is binder-only (IUtteranceProviderService / IUtteranceReceiverCallback).

features.name: Speaker enrollment (user sound model creation)
pipeline: record 5 utterances (+3 noisy, max 11), Enrollment.threshold 30
getSizeWhenCreateUserModel -> createUserModel(sm, keyword, user, n, ShortBuffer[], out, ConfidenceData)
checkRecordingsQuality / verifyUserRecording (impostor + energy checks)
mergeModel into the BigSoundModel, persisted per user (OneVoiceModelFileManager)
features.notes: ConfidenceData/opaque Header (CONFIDENCE_LEVELS, TIMESTAMP, KEYWORD_INDICES, PERFORMANCE_MODE) is the enrollment metadata block.

features.name: DNN voice activity detection
pipeline: assets/speech*.eai discovered by prefix scan in assets/ (speech_float.eai)
config from container Platform_UV/nn_vad: cmd.end.detection.timeout 4000, nnvad.len.future 0, nnvad.len.hangover 70, nnvad.threshold 891289 (=0.85 in Q20), cmd.end.detection.threshold 30
Vad::init dlopens libqvavad.so, dlsym(CAPI init), copies the model, calls the CAPI wrapper which drives eai_init_ex/eai_apply on libeai_floating.so
per-frame speech probability -> hangover/lookahead state machine -> end-of-command detection
features.notes: The eai2 file is a float model; its layer table is not decoded (see unknowns).

features.name: Speech recognition / transcription (Whisper)
pipeline: 16 kHz PCM -> whisper.cpp/ggml runtime (libwhisper_lib.so, 306 KB, encoder/decoder tensor names .attn.key.weight etc.)
encoder_model_quantized_cached.dlc + vocab.bin under ASR_binary/Whisper are downloaded at runtime (QESDK VOICEUI_API_START_DOWNLOAD), not shipped
transcript -> TTS / LLM service
features.notes: Model files are absent from the APK; the runtime libs (libSNPE.so, libwhisper_lib.so) are present. Static weights unavailable.

features.name: On-device end-point detection (EPD)
pipeline: log10 energy / SNR state machine on 10 ms frames (EPD.minSnrOnset 3.0, forgettingFactorNoise 0.03, numMinFramesInPhrase 15, preEmphasize 1)
used to bound utterances and to guard training frames (Training.numGuardFrames_for_epd 30/80)
features.notes: No NN; the only log10 call sites in libqvasml are EPD/noise-mixing/GMM code.

features.name: DSP-side wake-word modules (audio HAL)
entrypoints: libqvapdk.so / libqvapdkxs.so / libqvarnn.so / libqvauv.so -> capi_v2_get_static_properties, capi_v2_init
pipeline: CAPI_v2 modules loaded by audioserver; libqvapdkxs.so exposes tunables block_size, num_channels, eer_mode, n_min_req_frame_model_1..3, ignore_detect_model_1..3 (three detect models)
features.notes: Module identity from CAPI_v2 exports and libqvapdkxs.so tunables; the same library names are present in libqvajni.so .rodata next to libqvasml.so, so the JNI wrapper can dlopen either the CPU SML or the DSP CAPI_v2 back end. The DSP configuration flow itself is outside the APK.

models.verification: container parsed for all 7 uim files (reimpl/uim_container.py, evidence/uim_parse.txt); weights opaque

reimplementation.limitations: Front-end is exact (real Hann/mel coefficients extracted from libqvasml.so, 512-pt FFT, 256 magnitudes, 80 sparse triangular filters; numpy vs jax max abs diff 7.6e-06). Decision layer uses the real qvaconfig_v4.xml thresholds (Q20 VAD 0.85, hangover 70, keyword thresholds 26 / 50,52,49,37,35, tolerances). The four neural stages (DNN VAD, 1st stage, 1.5 stage, 2nd stage UV) are ARCHITECTURE_ONLY: the EAI2 blob layer tables are not decoded, so weights are deterministic pseudo-random with the documented shapes (5 keyword outputs for 1st/1.5 stage, 1 logit for VAD). Also provided: reimpl/uim_container.py decodes the .uim header and enumerates embedded EAI2 blobs for all 7 files.

unknowns: EAI2 (eai2) descriptor/layer table: no strings, no self-describing tags. Ghidra recovered the load chain inside libeai_floating.so (eai_init_internal @0x10c654 -> load_network @0x10d754 -> validate_eai_model / initialize_tensor_meta / parse_eai_layers @0x10dcd0 -> load_eai_layers -> initialize_io_tensor), but extract_eai_model_from_buffer, initialize_tensor_meta, calculate_total_layer_size and the per-op eai_op_layer_* loaders were not decompiled, so tensor shapes, op list, weight offsets and quantisation of every DNN (VAD, 1st/1.5-stage keyword, DNN-UV) remain opaque; only blob boundaries and the 16-byte container header are known.

.uim individual-model descriptors at 0x1A8 (count x 16 B) and the version-specific body tables (keyword ids, threshold seeds, user model tables) are parsed only at the container level; the field semantics beyond 'two nonzero u32 words per descriptor' are not proven.

UBM blobs: 2496 int16 means / 2496 int16 inverse variances + 64 int32 weights; whether the split is 64 mixtures x 39 dims or 32 x 78 and the fixed-point scale (means range -3279..2935, ivar 0..10122) are unverified.
Whisper ASR weights (encoder_model_quantized_cached.dlc, vocab.bin) are downloaded at runtime via QESDK; not present in the APK.

Whether the EAI networks apply log/CMVN internally: the native front-end outputs linear mel magnitudes and no logf call exists on that path; the reimplementation assumes log + per-utterance mean/variance (marked INFERRED).
DSP path (libqvapdk*, libqvarnn, libqvauv): CAPI_v2 modules configured by audioserver, no configuration visible in the APK.
Anti-spoof / ID-UV (libVoiceSdk.so, net.idrnd.voicesdk) model data and thresholds: only the switch UV.antiSpoofEnable=false / threshold 0.3 is visible.

data_pipelines.name: Always-on keyword detection (OneVoice): STHAL DSP trigger -> AudioRecord(HOTWORD) capture -> 1.5 stage -> 2nd stage UV -> client binder delivery

trigger.kind: sound-trigger HAL event (no app-side always-on capture)
trigger.startup: VoiceAssistApplication.onCreate -> p003d.g.x (Facade) + System.loadLibrary("qvajni"); BOOT_COMPLETED -> VoiceAssistReceiver -> ReenableWakewordService

transport.capture_source: AudioAttributes USAGE_MEDIA(1)/CONTENT_TYPE_SPEECH(1) + setInternalCapturePreset(1999); 1999 == AUDIO_SOURCE_HOTWORD is inferred from the platform constant
transport.client_audio_fd: ParcelFileDescriptor.createReliableSocketPair() (p009j.a), fd[0] handed to the client, fd[1] written by the capture task

threads: main Handler: completion callbacks and client unbind
synchronisation: ReentrantLock + Condition.await(10, SECONDS) in p013n.L; AtomicBoolean single-recognition gate in p013n.z; AudioStreamProvider drops a chunk when the buffer is full (p009j.h.l)

steps.mechanism: SoundTrigger.KeyphraseRecognitionEvent -> N.c -> com.quicinc.voice.activation.soundtrigger.RecognitionEvent (captureSession, beginIndex, endIndex, keywordId, confidence, isMultiKW)
p003d.d.d: PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK("Recognition") 500 ms, then g.n().i(uuid, event) -> p013n.z.i
audiorecord.b.w -> AudioStreamProvider(10 s) + OneShotAudioRecordAction -> AudioRecord(HOTWORD) -> 3840 B reads -> client PFD + IAudioStreamSaver
16 kHz PCM -> x*(1/32768) -> Hann(400) in 480 window -> 512-pt real FFT -> 256 magnitudes -> 80 sparse triangular mel filters (no log)
p015p.j.i(uuid, saver, kwStart, kwEnd); UV/TIUV Algorithm over TIUVReader (DNN-VAD bounded) or OneShotReader; threshold SecondStageUV.threshold (55.0/45.0 or 13.0/19.0)
ClientGroupManager -> ClientGroup by detectedIndex -> preferred Client -> package installed + RECORD_AUDIO granted
bindService(ComponentName(pkg, serviceClass), 0x100001 = BIND_AUTO_CREATE|BIND_IMPORTANT), extra isOneVoice=true only for the in-package LLM client
client calls IUtteranceProviderService -> n.z.k/q -> IUtteranceReceiverCallback.onUtteranceReceived(fd, bundle) / onUtteranceVerificationFailure(fd, bundle)

consumer.audio_payload: ParcelFileDescriptor of the socket pair = raw 16 kHz mono PCM16 of the utterance window

failure_fallback: no client group for the detected index -> "cannot find client group" -> p() abort, no delivery (confirmed)
2nd-stage model absent -> "model unsufficient" / ALGORITHM_NO_MODEL, 1st stage rolled back (confirmed)
client package missing or RECORD_AUDIO not granted -> abort + turnOffDetection (confirmed)
1.5 stage timeout -> Condition.await(10 s), then 1.5Stage.success=false -> abort (confirmed)
HAL abort/failure -> session RECOGNITION_PAUSED / all sessions ERROR + state cleared (confirmed)
STHAL service died -> E.n.d detach + re-attach on resources-available (confirmed)
screen_off_survival: detection itself runs in the sound-trigger HAL/DSP; the app only holds a registered SoundTriggerModule session
AudioRecord uses capture preset 1999 (AUDIO_SOURCE_HOTWORD) allowed for CAPTURE_AUDIO_HOTWORD holders
addPowerSaveTempWhitelistApp 300 s per capture (tag QVA-HOTWORD) + 500 ms PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK("Recognition")
ForegroundService with foregroundServiceType=0x80 (microphone) only on SDK 31/32 and MANUFACTURER in {OnePlus, OPPO, realme, Xiaomi}

data_pipelines.name: Speaker enrollment: per-utterance capture -> verifyUserRecording -> createUserModel -> per-user model file

transport.audio_source: from Enrollment.audiosource (AbstractEnrollmentSession.i(): DEFAULT=0, MIC=1, VOICE_UPLINK=2, VOICE_DOWNLINK=3, VOICE_CALL=4, CAMCORDER=5, VOICE_RECOGNITION=6 default, VOICE_COMMUNICATION=7, REMOTE_SUBMIX=8, UNPROCESSED=9)
transport.gate: EPD (default) or DNNVAD; loop breaks on end-of-phrase

steps.mechanism: EnrollmentType -> n.q (OneVoice PDK) | n.t0 (general UV -> general_UV/uv.udm) | M (legacy PDK)
n.g.v(ByteBuffer): loads the base sound model and reads Enrollment.audiosource + Enrollment.trainingPostRollPadding
n.g.y(id, cb) -> timer (n.f Handler, Enrollment.timeout) + TrainingAudioRecorder.r/J -> NormalAudioRecordAction (RecursiveAction)
n.g.z -> n.q.B -> SoundModelCodec.verifyUserRecording(model, utteranceId, ShortBuffer, postRollPadding, ConfidenceData) (JNI @0x15eb0)
EnrollmentService.p -> score = h() -> ParcelFileDescriptor.createReliablePipe -> callback.k(fd, {UVREnrollment.quality_score}) -> n.g.A writes the generated model into the pipe
u.g writes getFilesDir()/<container>/<clientGroup>/<userId|null>/{information.xml,<AlgorithmType>.binary}; general UV at getFilesDir()/general_UV/uv.udm
boot: ReenableWakewordService -> u.g.a(cb)/u.l.a(cb) -> n.Y re-arms the stored models

failure_fallback: RECORD_AUDIO not granted to the caller -> "permissions no granted" (confirmed)
missing session id -> "Session[...] is no found" (confirmed)
generate error -> "Generate error" when m() returns null (confirmed)
general model already exists -> logged, general-UV session reused (confirmed)
verify failure -> ConfidenceData carries the reason back to the client; utterance is not added to the model (inferred)
